pr_body: Implements the ADR 0121 Asset/Prefab parity slice on a fresh current-main baseline. Adds shared GUI-free prefab asset creation/loading, shared Scene preview/apply instantiation semantics with revision/generation stale protection, fresh AssetId manifest registration, CLI prefab create/preview/instantiate commands, MCP prefab.create/prefab.preview/prefab.instantiate tools, and routes existing Editor prefab creation/placement through the same services. Prefab preview is non-destructive; instantiate remains one Scene transaction/undo entry; normal Editor save policy remains authoritative. Supersedes stale Draft PR #41 after successful validation.
